relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: approximately 5% of SFN patients harbor a gain‐of‐function variant in SCN9A, the gene encoding the voltage‐gated sodium channel Nav1.7

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: The gene mutation causes dorsal root ganglion neuron hyperexcitability, resulting in SFN

relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: BCpain was significantly higher in the SFN‐SCN9A group compared to HCs (β = 0.43, 95% confidence interval [CI] [0.06, 0.80], p = 0.02)

key_findings: Nodal importance (betweenness centrality) of pain-associated regions (postcentral gyrus, insula, ACC, thalamus) was higher in SCN9A-associated SFN than in idiopathic SFN and controls.
Higher self-reported pain correlated with higher nodal importance only in SFN-SCN9A patients.
